section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna
ocr_text:
BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna                BE-103

(b) Tape player okay but no sound from AM and FM or
    either one.
    Possible causes:
    • Antenna disconnected
    • Antenna plug not properly connected
    • Defective antenna
    • Defective antenna booster
    • Defective antenna cable
    • Defective radio or tape player
    • Blown HAZ-HORN fuse
    • Short circuit or broken wire in wire harness for
      back-up power source
